degree5.finite_closed_form: Expand f_a^+*f_b^-*exp(2*pi*i*q*s)=sum_n P_n(s)exp(2*pi*i*n*s), deg(P_n)<=2, with n in {q,q+a,q-b,q+a-b} after omitting duplicate/zero-frequency terms. Then k=2*Re sum_n sum_j P_(n,j)*J_(j+1)(n), where J_0(0)=1, J_j(0)=1/(j+1), J_0(n)=0 for n!=0, and J_j(n)=1/(2*pi*i*n)-j*J_(j-1)(n)/(2*pi*i*n) for n!=0. Coefficients of f are exact rational multiples of (pi*i)^-1; thus this is a finite exact rational/pi expression for every feasible (a,b,q), including zero-lag polynomial factors.
